sn4.18:1.2: kumārikānaṁ pāhunakāni → kumārakānaṁ pāhuṇakāni (bj) | kumārikānaṁ → kumārakānaṁ (sya-all, pts) | kumārakānaṁ → B. kumārikānam. (pts note) | pāhunakāni → So B. and C.; SS. pāhunakānaṁ. (pts note)

sn4.18:2.3: tvaṁ →  (bj, sya-all, pts) | samaṇa → api tvaṁ samaṇa (bj: machasaṁ) | Api → B. adds te. (pts note)
sn4.18:2.4: pāpima → S1-2 Tathā no tuvam pāpimaṁ; S3 Tathā no tvaṁ pāpima. (pts note) | na → SS. omit na. (pts note)

sn4.18:2.6: lacchatīti → lacchatīti bhagavā (bj) | ti → S1-2 lacchāsīti. (pts note)
sn4.18:3.1: pasavi → pasavī (bj) | pasavi → SS. pasavī. (pts note)
sn4.18:3.2: āsajjanaṁ → S2 āsajjana-; S1 asajjana. (pts note)
sn4.18:3.4: vipaccati → SS. na me te pāpaṁ vipaccatīti. (pts note)
sn4.18:4.2: no → SS. yesanno; B. yesaṁnno. (pts note)
